name: v1.5.1
body: Adds a persistent, explicit sensor-monitoring pause and guards boot, charging and recovery paths from restarting paused monitoring. Shared power-policy changes reduce source-level sensor restart and sampling waste; driving GPS cadence and thresholds stay unchanged. SOS shake and official-alert checks remain separate. Human Safety downloads, update checks and installer handoff stay paused with the heat/battery advisory. This release does not establish that the reported heat or battery drain is fixed: do not install or use Human Safety until a verified fix is approved. CI and native renders passed; physical-device heat and battery improvement are not verified. The activity screen-awake flag remains unchanged. Stability/quarantine change, not a security patch.

name: v1.5.0
body:
- Choose a saved area or current location for automatic official alerts.
- Saved-area checks reuse the place stored on your phone; automatic earthquake matching filters the public USGS feed locally.
- Update or clear the saved area when you move.
- Changing area starts separate alert tracking; already queued alerts may still arrive.
- Manual Check now still sends coordinates to USGS.
- Android may delay alerts; this is not early warning.
- Physical-device/GPS/TTS/Doze testing is pending.

name: v1.4.32

name: v1.4.30

name: v1.4.29

name: v1.1.11
body: Hub now also reads the official NDMA SACHET alert list automatically about every 30 minutes and notifies you of a Severe or Extreme alert whose area text names your district, locality or state. Matched by area name only, not coordinates; Unavailable if no location. No new permission.

name: v1.1.10
body: Hub now checks USGS earthquakes automatically about every 30 minutes and notifies you of a new quake of magnitude 2.5 or more within 200 km. Uses your last known location; Unavailable if none. Not an official warning. No new permission.

name: v1.1.9
body: Safety screen has an Earthquakes near you card: earthquakes of magnitude 2.5 or more within 200 km in the last 7 days from the USGS public feed, read only when you tap Check now. Not an official warning. No new permission.

name: v1.1.8
body: Truth fix: the Dashboard no longer says Device Camera Lockout or Device Mic Lockout is Verified Secure. Hub cannot verify a lockout, so the camera row now says Camera found (lockout not checked) and the microphone row says Unavailable because Hub does not use the microphone. No new permission.

name: v1.1.7
body: Fixed wrong text: the Permissions list and first-run dialog no longer say the camera is used for Travel Checking or that Hub records audio. Each permission now states its real use. Skipping the first-run dialog is remembered. No new permission.

name: v1.1.6
body: New Permissions list in Settings: Location, SMS, Camera, Physical activity, Notifications, Bluetooth, Usage access, Exact alarms, Battery, Install apps, with the reason and live status for each. Tap a row to open the Android page. No new permission.

name: v1.1.5
body: Hub widget now shows battery temperature with charging state, plus steps today and your daily target from the Steps card. Anything not known shows Unavailable. Steps update when Hub is open. No new permission.

name: v1.1.4
body: Hub 1.1.4 - Steps today card now has an optional date of birth, a daily step target from published research (ages 6-19: 12000, 20-64: 10000, otherwise Unavailable) and a Target reached message. Date of birth stays on the phone. No new permission.

name: v1.1.3
body: Hub 1.1.3 - new Steps today card on Home from the phone step counter. Needs the Physical activity permission and shows Unavailable without it. Counted since the first reading of the day. No other change.

name: v1.1.2
body: Settings has a new Send crash report button that shows the exact text before anything is sent, or share it instead. Automatic crash reports now count as sent only when the service confirms. Nothing personal is included.

name: v1.1.1
body: What is new in 1.1.1: the header is now the Netra standard, 56 dp tall, showing only the app name, the installed version and the date and time. The SOS setup, Share location and Travel Checking buttons moved to the top of the scrolling Dashboard. The bottom bar stays fixed. SECURITY.md updated. No new permission or library.

name: v1.1.0
body: What is new in 1.1.0: the header now shows the installed version. The always green status dot and the account icon are removed because nothing real was behind them. The header SOS button is renamed SOS setup because it opens the SOS settings and does not send an SOS. The SOS tab icon is now a warning sign. SECURITY.md updated. No new permission or library.

name: v1.0.14

name: v1.0.12

name: v1.0.9

name: v1.0.8

name: v1.0.7

name: v1.0.6

name: v1.0.4
body: Patch: automatic crash reports. If the app crashes, the next open sends the report by itself (app, phone model, Android and app version, code locations only; no personal data).

name: v1.0.3

name: v1.0.2
